description: This file defines the AppLockManager class, which manages app locking and unlocking behavior, including biometric authentication, for the iOS application.

classes.name: AppLockManager
classes.description: An observable object managing app lock state with methods to lock, unlock, and handle biometric authentication.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the app UI until the user authenticates.

methods.name: unlockWithoutPrompt
methods.description: Unlocks the app UI without prompting for biometrics, used after logout.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Attempts to unlock the app using biometrics or passcode asynchronously.

methods.name: lockAndRequireAuthIfNeeded
methods.description: Locks the app and prompts for authentication when returning to foreground, if app lock is enabled.
